rb1.method: Read-only: GET /models on each endpoint and public model documentation. No inference, embedding or other billable request was sent.

switchyard.client_note: Cloudflare refused Python urllib's client signature (403, error 1010); curl succeeded. The adapters use httpx, which the gateway already accepts for chat completions.

nvidia-api-catalog.request: GET https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/models (no key needed for the listing)

nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reas.video: mp4, up to 2 minutes; up to 1 FPS / 128 frames at 1080p, 2 FPS / 256 frames at 720p or lower
nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reas.json: documented: 'Supports JSON output format' (strict json_schema not stated)

nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b.json: not documented as a serving parameter; tool calling documented

nvidia/cosmos-3-super-reasoner.note: Not on the public catalog (Switchyard only); no public documentation found.

nvidia/cosmos-3-nano-reasoner.note: Not on the public catalog (Switchyard only); no public documentation found.

nvidia/cosmos-reason2-8b.note: Listed on the catalog; its API reference page was not found (404).

nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b.note: Listed on the catalog; its API reference page was not found (404).

findings: Switchyard serves the three allowlisted P1 models (cosmos-3-nano-reasoner, cosmos-3-super-reasoner, nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning) and nemotron-3-ultra, the grounded chat default (P5): the configured ids are right for Switchyard.

The public catalog names two of them differently: nemotron-3-ultra is nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b and nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b is nvidia/nemotron-nano-3-30b-a3b. A subject on that endpoint must use the catalog id.
Cosmos 3 Super and Nano are not on the public catalog, so Track A on Cosmos runs through Switchyard only.

Switchyard lists only NVIDIA families (Cosmos, Nemotron), so a third-family judge (X19) is only reachable on the catalog (openai/gpt-oss-20b, mistralai/mistral-large-4-1t-a52b, google/gemma-4-31b-it, moonshotai/kimi-k2.6), which needs NVIDIA_API_KEY on the harness host (X18) for inference.
Still unverified without a model call: strict json_schema behaviour on each endpoint, base64 video input (X16 inline), and Switchyard's effective frame sampling (status known issue 15).
